blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Every "hi" is the start of a talk. Your first day at a new desk can feel big. But a simple sentence opens every door: "Hi, I'm Ana. I work at Czarnikow."

Today we practise I am and you are. We use them with the people and places we see every day. "I am a new trader." "You are my manager." "I am from São Paulo." "You are on my team."

Take your time. Every sentence counts. Say "hi", say your name, and start the conversation.

items.q: What does Ana say to open the conversation?
options: "Hi, I'm Ana. I work at Czarnikow."
items.why: O texto traz a frase exata: "Hi, I'm Ana. I work at Czarnikow."

items.q: What does the text say we practise today?
items.why: "Today we practise I am and you are."

items.q: The text says "Take your time." This suggests that…
options: you do not need to rush
you should not speak at all
items.why: Inferência: "take your time" = não tenha pressa, vá com calma.

items.q: The author would most likely AGREE that…
options: a simple hello can start a good conversation
the first day at work is easy for everyone
you should stay quiet on your first day
items.why: Inferência: o texto todo mostra que uma frase simples "opens every door".

items.q: Why does the text say the first day "can feel big"?
options: because everything is new for you
because the office is very large
because you have a big desk
items.why: Inferência: é o primeiro dia num lugar novo — tudo é novo, por isso parece "grande".

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver se apresentando no seu primeiro dia. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! My name is Oliver. I am a new trader here at Czarnikow. Today is my first day at the London office. It is a big day for me.

You are my manager, and you are very kind. Thank you very much. This is my desk. It is next to the window, and it is very nice. I am happy here. I have a computer, a phone, and a small plant on my desk.

My colleague is Ana. She sits close to me. She is friendly and calm. She says, "You are on my team now. Welcome!" That is very nice. I say, "Thank you, Ana. Nice to meet you."

I am from São Paulo, in Brazil. It is a big city, and I love it. Now I am here in London, and I am ready to work. I am a little nervous, but I am also happy. Every day I learn one new word in English.

So, hello, everyone. My name is Oliver. I am a trader, and you are my new team. I am glad to be here. Nice to meet you all.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the speaker's name?
items.why: "My name is Oliver."

items.q: What is Oliver's job?
items.why: "I am a new trader here at Czarnikow."

items.q: Where is Oliver from?
items.why: "I am from São Paulo, in Brazil."

items.q: Oliver says he is "a little nervous, but also happy." This suggests that…
options: he has mixed feelings on his first day
he does not like the office
items.why: Inferência: nervoso + feliz ao mesmo tempo = sentimentos misturados no primeiro dia.

items.q: "You are on my team now," says Ana. This suggests that…
options: Ana wants Oliver to feel welcome
items.why: Inferência: dizer "you are on my team now" é acolher o colega novo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "Ana is my colleague. We work together." A colleague is…
items.why: Colleague = colega, a pessoa com quem você trabalha.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Hi, my ___ is Oliver. Nice to meet you."
items.why: Name = nome; "my name is Oliver".

items.q: "My manager helps me and checks my work." A manager is…
options: the person who leads the team
items.why: Manager = gerente, quem lidera a equipe.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I sit at my ___ next to the window."
items.why: Desk = mesa (de trabalho); é onde a pessoa senta.

items.q: "Oliver is a trader at Czarnikow." A trader is a person who…
options: buys and sells for the company
items.why: Trader = quem compra e vende no mercado; a função de Oliver.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que usamos ao nos apresentar no trabalho. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: Someone says "thank you." You answer: "You are welcome." This means…
options: it is my pleasure / no problem
items.why: "You are welcome" = de nada; resposta gentil a um "obrigado".

items.q: Oliver says "Nice to meet you" to his new team. He uses this to…
options: greet people for the first time
say goodbye at the end of the day
items.why: "Nice to meet you" = prazer em conhecer; usado no primeiro encontro.

items.q: "I am ready to work." This means Oliver…
items.why: "Ready to work" = pronto para começar/trabalhar.

items.q: A colleague says "You are on my team." This means…
options: you work together in the same group
items.why: "On my team" = no meu time, no mesmo grupo de trabalho.

items.q: It is the morning. Oliver says "Good morning" to his desk neighbour. He uses this to…
options: greet someone early in the day
items.why: "Good morning" = bom dia; saudação usada de manhã.
